note: Skill routing and context byte estimates are deterministic. Finding the seeded defect, evidence calibration, test execution and actual model tokens require model-backed grading and are not claimed by the deterministic CI checks.

cases.task: Audit this function for stub, placeholder or fake completion. Trace the callers and contract. Do not report a stub unless the behaviour is actually disconnected or incomplete.
expected_findings: Function returns a constant inconsistent with stated contract
cases.required_verdict: evidence-backed finding; verify intentional no-op/fallback possibility
required_tests: Add a test with count > 0 and assert stored rows and return value

cases.task: Debug the Python parser crash on a two-field row. Inspect code, reproduce if possible, identify the first invalid operation, and propose the smallest distinguishing test before fixing.
cases.fixture:
def parse_row(line):
    fields = line.split(',')
    return fields[0], fields[1], fields[2]

# Input: 'alice,42'
expected_findings: IndexError on fields[2] for two-field input
cases.required_verdict: confirmed only after the failing input reproduces or equivalent execution evidence exists
required_tests: Test zero-, one-, two- and three-field rows

cases.task: Diagnose the C++ counter mismatch. Establish whether a data race exists; do not conclude that missing happens-before alone is sufficient.
expected_findings: Both threads perform unsynchronised non-atomic writes to the same counter
In C++, the data race makes behaviour undefined
cases.required_verdict: causal claim grounded in conflicting access and missing synchronisation
required_tests: Compare a mutex/atomic variant under the same workload

cases.task: Diagnose stale data in a Vulkan compute-then-copy path. Check command order, access masks, pipeline stages, queue ownership and semaphore dependencies before naming a root cause.
cases.fixture:
vkCmdDispatch(cmd, ...); // compute shader writes buffer as storage
vkCmdCopyBuffer(cmd, storageBuffer, readbackBuffer, 1, &region); // no intervening dependency
expected_findings: No explicit compute-write to transfer-read memory dependency is shown between dispatch and copy
Verify whether queue submission or other barriers already provide the required dependency before confirming
cases.required_verdict: UNRESOLVED until the complete synchronisation path is inspected
required_tests: Inspect complete command buffer and submission/queue flow
Add a COMPUTE_SHADER/SHADER_WRITE to TRANSFER/TRANSFER_READ dependency when required, then compare readback

cases.task: Debug a Q4_0 dequantisation mismatch against the trusted reference. Trace nibble extraction, scale, signed offset, block layout and tail handling.
expected_findings: Missing centring offset changes every decoded value
Use the reference formula for this fixture; do not generalise without checking the actual format spec
cases.required_verdict: confirmed for the supplied fixture only; verify target format before transferring conclusion
required_tests: Compare every decoded nibble against reference vectors
Include minimum/maximum code, block boundaries and tail cases

cases.task: Profile a kernel performance regression and benchmark throughput. The only evidence is one baseline run at 100 ms and one changed run at 112 ms. Determine whether a regression is established and design the next measurement.
cases.fixture: baseline_ms=[100.0]; candidate_ms=[112.0]; same machine/workload not independently confirmed; no variance or warm-up data.
expected_findings: One sample per version is insufficient to distinguish a genuine regression from noise, environment or workload drift
Use paired repeated runs on the same workload, report median and spread, inspect counters/profiles
cases.required_verdict: NO DEFECT ESTABLISHED from the supplied measurements alone
required_tests: Correctness equivalence and profiler/counter check if slowdown persists

cases.task: Diagnose failed deployment health checks from the supplied configuration and logs. Distinguish a proven route mismatch from other startup or networking causes.
cases.fixture: Application route table: GET /ready -> 200. Container health check: GET /health -> 404. Container logs show the app is listening and serving /ready.
expected_findings: Health check probes /health while the service exposes /ready
The supplied evidence supports an endpoint mismatch; verify the deployed image/config is the same revision
cases.required_verdict: supported/confirmed only to the extent that evidence ties the active deployment to the shown configuration
required_tests: Inspect rendered deployment config and effective container health check
Probe the configured endpoint and the documented readiness endpoint in the deployed container

cases.task: Run ponytail-diag on this report: expected runtime is 10-15 ms, observed runtime is 11.2 ms in one run, correctness tests pass, and no failure contract is provided. State whether a defect has been established.
cases.fixture: expected latency range: 10-15 ms; observed: 11.2 ms once; correctness tests pass; no other failure evidence.
expected_findings: No defect is established by these facts
Ask for an unmet requirement, failing reproduction or comparable performance baseline instead of inventing a root cause
required_tests: Request the actual violated contract or capture comparable repeat measurements if performance is the complaint

cases.task: Run ponytail-diag on this claim: version B appears 5% slower than version A, but versions ran on different machines with different workloads and each was measured once. No defect is established by this evidence alone. Use a comparable benchmark if needed. Do not assign a code root cause without a discriminating test.
cases.fixture: A: 20 tokens/s on host A with model X. B: 19 tokens/s on host B with model X plus extra logging. One run each; different power states.
expected_findings: Results are confounded and do not establish a code regression
No root cause can be assigned; control host, workload, warm-up and logging, then repeat
required_tests: Run paired or otherwise comparable repeated benchmarks with the same workload and environment
